chapter: Jump for Joy, records and royalties
title: Ellington summons him to California for 'Jump for Joy'
summary: A telegram from Ellington brought him to the Dunbar Hotel in Los Angeles; he learned the songs and modeled suits.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: So, one day I got a telegram. He sent it down to the nightclub-- down at Barney Josephson's place. Duke Ellington, he sent for me, told me to come to California. He want me to be in his show. So I told Barney Josephson. He didn't want me to leave so I told him, I said, "I go out there and do his show, and I'll come back."

So, about a month later, I hit 'em. I come to California. I went to the Dunbar Hotel over there on Forty-First and Central--some- where over there. So I stayed in the room for three or four days and didn't come out. So I could hear where the room I had, you could hear that echo between the building...ever'body havin' fun and ever'thing downstairs. They had a bar downstairs. Jukebox jumpin' off the wall playin' my numbers...playin' my records. So I says...so when I was rehearsin' with Duke Ellington for the show, so I was tryin' to learn the
words to the songs that he wants me to sing in there, so I was stickin' pretty close. So finally I got lucky. I learnt the words 'n' ever'thing, an' they put me on the show.

First, I was just doin' two numbers. Then, awhile later, I was doin' three. Next thing you know, I was in four or five different acts on the show. I was all through the show. Excuse me. An' I run into a tailor downtown...used to be a tailor downtown, an' he wanted me to model some clothes for him, so he'd make me up all these fine suits. I hit the stage every day with a new suit on. Cats say, "This cat's some sharp." that "He's really on!" And Duke...even now Duke Ellington, he wonder where I come up with all these clothes. I wasn't buyin' them. The man was makin' 'em for me just to model for him. I don't know why he picked me. He just liked me, took me, told me he wanted me to model for him.
You must have made the clothes look good.
